    function auctionSuggestedCalls(limit = 4) {
      if (
        !auctionCallMode()
        || !(auctionHasPresidentRole() || auctionHasViceRole())
      ) {
        return [];
      }

      return (state.auction?.callCandidates || [])
        .map(auctionSuggestedCallScore)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) =>
          b.score - a.score
          || Number(b.player?.pfc || 0) - Number(a.player?.pfc || 0)
          || Number(b.player?.pma || 0) - Number(a.player?.pma || 0)
          || String(a.player?.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.player?.name || ''), 'it')
        )
        .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(limit || 4)));
    }

    function auctionQueueCapacityForPlayer(player) {
      const queue =
        auctionQueueRows();

      /*
       * La Coda è una lista strategica, non una proiezione vincolante della
       * rosa finale: può quindi contenere anche giocatori di backup oltre i
       * massimi di rosa/ruolo. L'unico limite tecnico resta quello del backend
       * (50 record per salvataggio della Coda).
       */
      if (queue.length >= 50) {
        return {
          allowed: false,
          backup: false,
          message: 'La coda può contenere al massimo 50 giocatori.'
        };
      }

      if (!player) {
        return {
          allowed: true,
          backup: false,
          message: ''
        };
      }

      const hypothetical = [
        ...queue,
        {
          player_id: player.id,
          player
        }
      ];

      const projected =
        auctionQueueProjection(hypothetical);

      const stateForPlayer =
        projected[projected.length - 1]
        || null;

      return {
        allowed: true,
        backup:
          stateForPlayer?.backup === true,
        message:
          stateForPlayer?.reason || ''
      };
    }

    function auctionSuggestedCallScore(player) {
      const d = state.auction || {};
      const info = auctionMyTeamDashboardData();

      if (!player || !info) {
        return null;
      }

      if (!auctionPlayerMatchesCurrentRolePhase(player)) {
        return null;
      }

      const capacity = auctionQueueCapacityForPlayer(player);
      if (!capacity.allowed) {
        return null;
      }

      if (
        auctionQueueRows()
          .some(item => item.player_id === player.id)
      ) {
        return null;
      }

      const mode = d.settings?.fantasy_mode || 'classic';
      const assignments = info.assignments || [];
      const queue = auctionQueueRows();
      let needScore = 0;
      let needLabel = '';

      if (mode === 'classic') {
        const role = player.classic_role || '—';
        const min = Number(info.roleLimits?.[role]?.min || 0);
        const acquired = assignments.filter(item => item.player?.classic_role === role).length;
        const queued = queue.filter(item => item.player?.classic_role === role).length;
        const missing = Math.max(0, min - acquired);
        const uncovered = Math.max(0, min - acquired - queued);

        needScore =
          uncovered > 0
            ? 70 + Math.min(20, uncovered * 8)
            : missing > 0
              ? 42
              : 8;

        needLabel =
          uncovered > 0
            ? `Mancano ${uncovered} ${role} al minimo`
            : missing > 0
              ? `${role} già coperto in Coda, ma non ancora acquistato`
              : `Slot ${role} ancora disponibile`;
      } else {
        const goalkeeper = playerRoles(player, mode)
          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
        const bucket = goalkeeper ? 'Por' : 'MOV';
        const label = goalkeeper ? 'portieri' : 'movimento';
        const min = Number(info.roleLimits?.[bucket]?.min || 0);
        const isGoalkeeper = candidate => playerRoles(candidate || {}, mode)
          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
        const acquired = assignments.filter(item => goalkeeper === isGoalkeeper(item.player)).length;
        const queued = queue.filter(item => goalkeeper === isGoalkeeper(item.player)).length;

          : `${label[0].toUpperCase()+label.slice(1)} compatibile con la rosa`;
      }

      const pma = Number(player.pma || 0);
      const expectedFm = Number(player.expected_fantasy_avg || 0);
      const tit = Number(player.expected_titolarity || 0);
      const quotation = Number(player.quotation || 0);
      const slot = Number(player.slot || 0);
      const maxBid = Number(info.maxBid ?? info.remaining ?? 0);

      let valueScore =
        Math.min(24, Math.max(0, pfc) * .18)
        + Math.min(18, Math.max(0, pma) * .12)
        + Math.min(12, Math.max(0, expectedFm) * 1.1)
        + Math.min(10, Math.max(0, tit) * .10);

              : `Slot ${role} ancora disponibile`;
      } else {
        const goalkeeper = playerRoles(player, mode)
          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
        const bucket = goalkeeper ? 'Por' : 'MOV';
        const label = goalkeeper ? 'portieri' : 'movimento';
        const min = Number(info.roleLimits?.[bucket]?.min || 0);
        const isGoalkeeper = candidate => playerRoles(candidate || {}, mode)
          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
        const acquired = assignments.filter(item => goalkeeper === isGoalkeeper(item.player)).length;
        const queued = queue.filter(item => goalkeeper === isGoalkeeper(item.player)).length;
        const uncovered = Math.max(0, min - acquired - queued);

        needScore = uncovered > 0 ? 76 + Math.min(18, uncovered * 7) : 10;
        needLabel = uncovered > 0
          ? `Mancano ${uncovered} ${label} al minimo`
          : `${label[0].toUpperCase()+label.slice(1)} compatibile con la rosa`;
      }

      const pfc = Number(player.pfc || 0);
      const pma = Number(player.pma || 0);
      const expectedFm = Number(player.expected_fantasy_avg || 0);
      const tit = Number(player.expected_titolarity || 0);
      const quotation = Number(player.quotation || 0);
      const slot = Number(player.slot || 0);
      const maxBid = Number(info.maxBid ?? info.remaining ?? 0);

      let valueScore =
        Math.min(24, Math.max(0, pfc) * .18)
        + Math.min(18, Math.max(0, pma) * .12)
        + Math.min(12, Math.max(0, expectedFm) * 1.1)
        + Math.min(10, Math.max(0, tit) * .10);

      if (slot > 0) {
        valueScore += Math.max(0, 14 - slot * 2.5);
      }

      let budgetScore = 0;
      if (quotation > 0 && maxBid > 0) {
        const ratio = quotation / maxBid;
        budgetScore =
          ratio <= .20 ? 14 :
          ratio <= .35 ? 11 :
          ratio <= .50 ? 7 :
          ratio <= .75 ? 3 : -8;
      }

      const backupPenalty =
        capacity.backup === true
          ? 38
          : 0;

      const score =
        needScore
        + valueScore
        + budgetScore
        - backupPenalty;

      let secondary = '';
      if (pfc > 0 || pma > 0) {
        secondary = `PFC ${pfc || '—'} · PMA ${pma || '—'}`;
      } else if (slot > 0) {
        secondary = `Slot ${slot}`;
      } else if (quotation > 0) {
        secondary = `Qt. ${quotation}`;
      }

      return {
        player,
        score,
        reason:
          capacity.backup
            ? `${needLabel} · Backup oltre capienza attuale`
            : needLabel,
        secondary,
        quotation,
        slot
      };
    }


    function auctionSuggestedCalls(limit = 4) {
      if (
        !auctionCallMode()
        || !(auctionHasPresidentRole() || auctionHasViceRole())
      ) {
        return [];
      }

      return (state.auction?.callCandidates || [])
        .map(auctionSuggestedCallScore)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) =>
          b.score - a.score
          || Number(b.player?.pfc || 0) - Number(a.player?.pfc || 0)
          || Number(b.player?.pma || 0) - Number(a.player?.pma || 0)
          || String(a.player?.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.player?.name || ''), 'it')
        )
        .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(limit || 4)));
    }

  function v7SuggestionContextKey() {
    return [auctionSession()?.id || '', auctionMyTeamId() || '', state.auction?.rolePhase?.key || 'free'].join('|');
  }

  function v7Dismissed() {
    const key = v7SuggestionContextKey();
    if (state.v7SuggestedDismissKey !== key) {
      state.v7SuggestedDismissKey = key;
      state.v7SuggestedDismissed = [];
    }
    return state.v7SuggestedDismissed;
  }

  function v7MantraFit(player) {
    if ((state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode || 'classic') === 'classic') return 0;
    const roles = playerRoles(player || {}, state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode);
    const flexibility = new Set(roles).size;
    return flexibility >= 3 ? 12 : flexibility === 2 ? 7 : flexibility === 1 ? 2 : 0;
  }

  function v7StrategicPrices(player, baseScore = 0) {
    const info = auctionMyTeamDashboardData();
    const pref = v7Preference(player);
    const pfc = Math.max(0, Number(player?.pfc || 0));
    const pma = Math.max(0, Number(player?.pma || 0));
    const quotation = Math.max(0, Number(player?.quotation || 0));
    const anchor = pfc || pma || quotation || 1;

    const historicalFactor = pfc > 0 && pma > 0 ? clamp(pma / pfc, .84, 1.16) : 1;
    const sameRole = new Set(playerRoles(player || {}, state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode));
    const liveRatios = (state.auction?.recentAwards || [])
      .filter(award => {
        const ap = award?.player || {};
        const price = Number(award?.price || award?.amount || 0);
        const ref = Number(ap?.pfc || 0);
        return price > 0 && ref > 0 && playerRoles(ap, state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode).some(r => sameRole.has(r));
      })
      .slice(0, 8)
      .map(award => clamp(Number(award.price || award.amount) / Number(award.player?.pfc || 1), .65, 1.55));
    const liveFactor = liveRatios.length
      ? clamp(liveRatios.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / liveRatios.length, .82, 1.22)
      : 1;

    const corrected = anchor * (.78 + historicalFactor * .12 + liveFactor * .10);
    const scoreBoost = baseScore >= 90 ? .12 : baseScore >= 70 ? .08 : baseScore >= 45 ? .04 : 0;
    let suggested = Math.max(1, Math.round(corrected * (1 + scoreBoost)));
    let ceiling = Math.max(suggested, Math.round(corrected * (1.12 + scoreBoost)));

    if (pref?.expected_spend != null) suggested = Math.max(1, Math.round((suggested * 2 + Number(pref.expected_spend)) / 3));
    if (pref?.max_price != null) ceiling = Math.min(ceiling, Math.max(1, Number(pref.max_price)));

    const budget = Number(info?.maxBid);
    if (Number.isFinite(budget)) {
      ceiling = Math.min(ceiling, Math.max(0, budget));
      suggested = Math.min(suggested, ceiling);
    }

    return { suggested, ceiling, pfc, pma, liveFactor };
  }

  const originalSuggestedScore = auctionSuggestedCallScore;
  auctionSuggestedCallScore = function(player) {
    const item = originalSuggestedScore(player);
    if (!item) return null;
    const pref = v7Preference(player);
    const stat = v7Stat(player);
    const features = stat?.features || {};
    const preferenceBoost = pref?.strategy === 'top' ? 28 : pref?.is_favorite ? 14 : pref?.strategy === 'avoid' ? -90 : 0;
    const priorityBoost = Math.max(0, Number(pref?.priority || 0)) * 4;
    const trendBoost = Math.round(Number(features.trend_age_adjusted || 0) * 18);
    const confidenceBoost = Math.round(Number(features.trend_confidence || 0) * 4);
    const mantraBoost = v7MantraFit(player);
    item.score += preferenceBoost + priorityBoost + trendBoost + confidenceBoost + mantraBoost;
    item.preference = pref;
    item.features = features;
    item.mantraFit = mantraBoost;
    item.prices = v7StrategicPrices(player, item.score);
    return item;
  };

      .filter(Boolean)
      .filter(item => !dismissed.has(String(item.player?.id || '')))
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || String(a.player?.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.player?.name || ''), 'it'));
    return all.slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(limit || 4)));
  };

    const pma = Math.max(0, Number(player?.pma || 0));

    const anchor = pfc || pma || quotation || 1;

    const historicalFactor = pfc > 0 && pma > 0 ? clamp(pma / pfc, .84, 1.16) : 1;
    const sameRole = new Set(playerRoles(player || {}, state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode));
    const liveRatios = (state.auction?.recentAwards || [])
      .filter(award => {
        const ap = award?.player || {};
        const price = Number(award?.price || award?.amount || 0);
        const ref = Number(ap?.pfc || 0);
        return price > 0 && ref > 0 && playerRoles(ap, state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode).some(r => sameRole.has(r));
      })
      .slice(0, 8)
      .map(award => clamp(Number(award.price || award.amount) / Number(award.player?.pfc || 1), .65, 1.55));
    const liveFactor = liveRatios.length
      ? clamp(liveRatios.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / liveRatios.length, .82, 1.22)
      : 1;

    const corrected = anchor * (.78 + historicalFactor * .12 + liveFactor * .10);
    const scoreBoost = baseScore >= 90 ? .12 : baseScore >= 70 ? .08 : baseScore >= 45 ? .04 : 0;
    let suggested = Math.max(1, Math.round(corrected * (1 + scoreBoost)));
    let ceiling = Math.max(suggested, Math.round(corrected * (1.12 + scoreBoost)));

    if (pref?.expected_spend != null) suggested = Math.max(1, Math.round((suggested * 2 + Number(pref.expected_spend)) / 3));
    if (pref?.max_price != null) ceiling = Math.min(ceiling, Math.max(1, Number(pref.max_price)));

    const budget = Number(info?.maxBid);
    if (Number.isFinite(budget)) {
      ceiling = Math.min(ceiling, Math.max(0, budget));
      suggested = Math.min(suggested, ceiling);
    }

    return { suggested, ceiling, pfc, pma, liveFactor };
  }

  const originalSuggestedScore = auctionSuggestedCallScore;
  auctionSuggestedCallScore = function(player) {
    const item = originalSuggestedScore(player);
    if (!item) return null;
    const pref = v7Preference(player);
    const stat = v7Stat(player);
    const features = stat?.features || {};
    const preferenceBoost = pref?.strategy === 'top' ? 28 : pref?.is_favorite ? 14 : pref?.strategy === 'avoid' ? -90 : 0;
    const priorityBoost = Math.max(0, Number(pref?.priority || 0)) * 4;
    const trendBoost = Math.round(Number(features.trend_age_adjusted || 0) * 18);
    const confidenceBoost = Math.round(Number(features.trend_confidence || 0) * 4);
    const mantraBoost = v7MantraFit(player);
    item.score += preferenceBoost + priorityBoost + trendBoost + confidenceBoost + mantraBoost;
    item.preference = pref;
    item.features = features;
    item.mantraFit = mantraBoost;
    item.prices = v7StrategicPrices(player, item.score);
    return item;
  };

  const originalSuggestedCalls = auctionSuggestedCalls;
  auctionSuggestedCalls = function(limit = 4) {
    const dismissed = new Set(v7Dismissed().map(String));
    const all = (state.auction?.callCandidates || [])
      .map(auctionSuggestedCallScore)
      .filter(Boolean)
      .filter(item => !dismissed.has(String(item.player?.id || '')))
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || String(a.player?.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.player?.name || ''), 'it'));
    return all.slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(limit || 4)));
  };

  function v7BindSuggestions(root = document) {
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-v7-dismiss]').forEach(button => {
      if (button.dataset.v7Bound) return; button.dataset.v7Bound = '1';
      button.addEventListener('click', event => {
        event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
        const id = String(button.dataset.v7Dismiss || '');
        if (id && !v7Dismissed().includes(id)) v7Dismissed().push(id);
        const holder = document.querySelector('.auction-free-suggestions');
        if (holder) { holder.innerHTML = renderAuctionSuggestedCalls(); attachAuctionCallQueueEvents(); }
      });
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-v7-detail]').forEach(row => {
      if (row.dataset.v7Bound) return; row.dataset.v7Bound = '1';
      const open = event => {
        if (event.target.closest('button')) return;
        if (event.type === 'keydown' && !['Enter',' '].includes(event.key)) return;
        event.preventDefault(); v7SuggestionModal(row.dataset.v7Detail);
      };
      row.addEventListener('click', open); row.addEventListener('keydown', open);
    });
  }

  const originalAttachQueue = attachAuctionCallQueueEvents;

    const value = originalAttachQueue(...args); v7BindSuggestions(document); return value;
  };

  function v7PatchLive() {
    const p = state.auction?.currentPlayer;
    if (p) {
      const item = auctionSuggestedCallScore(p);
      const prices = item?.prices || v7StrategicPrices(p, item?.score || 0);
      document.querySelectorAll('.auction-command-player small').forEach(meta => {
        if (!meta.querySelector('.auction-v7-live-price')) meta.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<span class="auction-v7-live-price"> · SUGG ${prices.suggested} · MAX ${prices.ceiling}${item ? ` · SCORE ${clamp(Math.round(item.score),0,100)}` : ''}</span>`);
      });
    }

    const info = auctionMyTeamDashboardData();
    const head = document.querySelector('.auction-team-column-roster-only .auction-team-roster-head');
    if (info && head && !head.querySelector('.auction-v7-roster-metrics')) {
      const max = Math.max(1, Number(info.rosterMax || info.rosterLimit || info.rosterMin || 1));
      const comp = Math.round((info.assignments.length / max) * 100);
      const fv = Math.round(info.assignments.reduce((sum, a) => sum + Number(a.player?.pfc || a.player?.quotation || 0), 0));
      const tit = info.assignments.map(a => Number(a.player?.expected_titolarity)).filter(Number.isFinite);
      const sol = tit.length ? Math.round(tit.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / tit.length) : null;
      head.querySelector('.auction-roster-head-actions')?.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', `<span class="auction-v7-roster-metrics" title="Completezza rosa · Fantavalore PFC · Solidità media titolarità">COMP ${comp}% <i>|</i> FV ${fv || '—'} <i>|</i> SOL ${sol ?? '—'}${sol !== null ? '%' : ''}</span>`);
    }
    v7BindSuggestions(document);
  }

  function v7CenterHtml() {
    const prefs = [...state.v7Preferences.values()];
    const fav = prefs.filter(p => p.is_favorite).length;
    const top = prefs.filter(p => p.strategy === 'top').length;
    const avoid = prefs.filter(p => p.strategy === 'avoid').length;
    const planned = prefs.reduce((sum,p) => sum + Number(p.expected_spend || 0), 0);
    return `<section class="panel auction-v7-center"><div class="between"><div><strong>Centro Strategico</strong><div class="small soft">Preferenze private · statistiche · piano d’asta</div></div><span class="badge primary">V6Y+</span></div><div class="auction-v7-center-grid"><span><small>Preferiti</small><b>${fav}</b></span><span><small>Top target</small><b>${top}</b></span><span><small>Da evitare</small><b>${avoid}</b></span><span><small>Budget pianificato</small><b>${planned}</b></span></div></section>`;
  }

  function v7PatchCenter() {
    const root = document.getElementById('auction-root');
    if (!root || root.querySelector('.auction-v7-center')) return;
    const lobby = root.querySelector('.auction-lobby');
    if (lobby) lobby.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', v7CenterHtml());
    else if (auctionSession()?.status === 'prepared') root.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', v7CenterHtml());
  }

  function v7OpenDb() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const req = indexedDB.open('fantacalcio_v6y', 1);
      req.onupgradeneeded = () => { if (!req.result.objectStoreNames.contains('cache')) req.result.createObjectStore('cache'); };
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result); req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });
  }
  async function v7CachePut(key, value) {
    try { const db = await v7OpenDb(); const tx = db.transaction('cache','readwrite'); tx.objectStore('cache').put(value,key); } catch {}
  }
  async function v7CacheGet(key) {
    try { const db = await v7OpenDb(); return await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ const r=db.transaction('cache').objectStore('cache').get(key); r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result); r.onerror=()=>reject(r.error); }); } catch { return null; }
  }

  async function v7SyncCatalog() {
    const leagueId = state.selectedLeague?.id; if (!leagueId || !state.auction) return;
    const key = `catalog:${leagueId}`;
    const cached = await v7CacheGet(key);
    if ((!state.auction.callCandidates || !state.auction.callCandidates.length) && cached?.players?.length) state.auction.callCandidates = cached.players;
    const response = await v7Api({ action: cached?.asOf ? 'getAuctionCatalogDelta' : 'getAuctionCatalog', since: cached?.asOf || undefined });
    if (!response) return;

    return fv+(pr-65)*.0025-rk*.07+tr*.045+favBoost;
  }

  function v11SlotCandidates(players,slot,includeFav){
    const raw=players.filter(p=>compatible(p,slot)).map(p=>{
      const pr=Math.max(1,Math.round(basePrice(p)));
      const quality=v11StarterQuality(p,includeFav);
      return {p,pr,quality,raw:Math.max(0,Number(forecast(p)||0))};
    });
    const premium=[...raw].sort((a,b)=>b.quality-a.quality||a.pr-b.pr).slice(0,14);
    const value=[...raw].sort((a,b)=>(b.quality/Math.pow(b.pr,.16))-(a.quality/Math.pow(a.pr,.16))).slice(0,8);
    const cheap=[...raw].sort((a,b)=>a.pr-b.pr||b.quality-a.quality).slice(0,6);
    const uniq=new Map();
    [...premium,...value,...cheap].forEach(x=>uniq.set(String(x.p.id),x));
    return [...uniq.values()];
  }

  function v11OptimiseSlots(players,slots,budget,includeFav){
    const hard=Math.max(slots.length,Math.floor(Number(budget)||0));
    const lists=slots.map(slot=>v11SlotCandidates(players,slot,includeFav));
    if(lists.some(x=>!x.length))return null;
    const order=[...slots.keys()].sort((a,b)=>lists[a].length-lists[b].length);
    let beam=[{score:0,raw:0,spent:0,used:new Set(),line:Array(slots.length).fill(null)}];
    const width=150;
    for(let step=0;step<order.length;step++){
      const idx=order[step],next=[],remaining=order.length-step-1;
      for(const st of beam){
        for(const c of lists[idx]){
          const id=String(c.p.id);
          if(st.used.has(id))continue;
          if(st.spent+c.pr+remaining>hard)continue;
          const used=new Set(st.used);used.add(id);
          const line=st.line.slice();line[idx]=c;
          next.push({score:st.score+c.quality,raw:st.raw+c.raw,spent:st.spent+c.pr,used,line});
        }
      }
      if(!next.length)return null;
      next.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||b.raw-a.raw||a.spent-b.spent);
      const seen=new Set(),trim=[];
      for(const st of next){
        const sig=st.line.map(x=>x?String(x.p.id):'').join('|');
        if(seen.has(sig))continue;
        seen.add(sig);trim.push(st);
        if(trim.length>=width)break;
      }
      beam=trim;
    }
    return beam[0]||null;
  }

  function chooseModule(players,budget,includeFav){
    let best=null;
    for(const id of moduleSlots()){
      const slots=MODS[id];
      const opt=v11OptimiseSlots(players,slots,budget,includeFav);
      if(!opt)continue;
      const line=opt.line.map((x,i)=>({p:x.p,pr:x.pr,slot:slots[i].join('/')}));
      const rank=opt.raw*100+opt.score;
      if(!best||rank>best.rank){
        best={id,line,spent:opt.spent,value:opt.raw,rank,used:new Set(line.map(x=>x.p.id))};
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  function softModuleBoost(p){
    if(mode()!=='mantra') return 0;
    const selected=(state.v8Profile?.preferred_modules||[]).filter(x=>MODS[x]);
    if(!selected.length) return 0;
    const rr=new Set(roles(p));
    let fit=0;
    selected.forEach(id=>{
      const slots=MODS[id]||[];
      const matches=slots.filter(slot=>slot.some(r=>rr.has(r))).length;
      fit=Math.max(fit,matches/Math.max(1,slots.length));
    });
    return fit>=.27?4:fit>=.18?2:fit>0?1:0;
  }

  const prevScore=auctionSuggestedCallScore;
  auctionSuggestedCallScore=function(p){

    if(pf?.is_favorite||pf?.strategy==='top'){
      if(cap==null) favoriteBoost=pf?.strategy==='top'?7:4;
      else if(predicted<=cap) favoriteBoost=pf?.strategy==='top'?9:6;

    }

    x.favoritePriceFit=cap==null?null:predicted/cap;

  };

(()=>{
  'use strict';
  if(window.__FANTA_V20_FIXED_INDEX__)return;
  window.__FANTA_V20_FIXED_INDEX__=1;

  /*
   * INDICE V20
   * Valore fisso in crediti della produzione fantacalcistica attesa.
   * NON usa PFC, PMA, prezzo atteso, soglia, offerte o andamento mercato.
   *
   * 1) Target stagionale ancora da produrre = media-vittoria × giornate residue.
   * 2) Ogni fantapunto utile vale = budget iniziale / target stagionale.
   * 3) Punti utili giocatore = FMV × gare attese × peso utilizzo fantasy.
   * 4) Indice = punti utili × crediti per fantapunto.
   *
   * Gare attese include titolarità prevista e indisponibilità note.
   * Il peso utilizzo fantasy evita di valorizzare allo stesso modo titolari e riserve:
   * slot 1-3 sono presumibilmente da XI, slot 4-8 progressivamente da rotazione/panchina.
   */
  const V20_SLOT_USAGE=Object.freeze({1:1.00,2:.92,3:.80,4:.55,5:.38,6:.26,7:.16,8:.10});
  const n20=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null;
  const clamp20=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));

  function v20NextRound(){return clamp20(Number(state.v13NextRound||state.setup?.next_round||1),1,38);}
  function v20RoundsRemaining(){return Math.max(0,39-v20NextRound());}
  function v20Fmv(player){
    const v=typeof strategicExpectedFantasyAverage==='function'?n20(strategicExpectedFantasyAverage(player)):n20(player?.expected_fantasy_avg);
    return Math.max(0,v??0);
  }
  function v20Presence(player){
    const v=typeof strategicPresencePercent==='function'?n20(strategicPresencePercent(player)):n20(player?.expected_titolarity);
    return clamp20(v??0,0,100);
  }
  function v20ExpectedGames(player){
    const remaining=v20RoundsRemaining();
    const next=v20NextRound();
    const until=Math.max(0,n20(player?.unavailable_until_round)??0);
    const forcedMiss=until>=next?Math.min(remaining,until-next+1):0;
    const available=Math.max(0,remaining-forcedMiss);
    return available*v20Presence(player)/100;
  }
  function v20SlotUsage(player){
    const slot=clamp20(Math.round(n20(player?.slot)??4),1,8);
    return V20_SLOT_USAGE[slot]??.55;
  }
  function v20TargetAverage(){
    const v=typeof strategicWinningTargetAverage==='function'?n20(strategicWinningTargetAverage()):null;
    return Math.max(1,v??72);
  }
  function v20InitialBudget(){
    return Math.max(1,n20(state.auction?.settings?.initial_credits)??n20(state.setup?.initial_credits)??500);
  }
  function v20CreditPerPoint(){
    const totalTarget=v20TargetAverage()*v20RoundsRemaining();
    return totalTarget>0?v20InitialBudget()/totalTarget:0;
  }
  function v20RawSeasonPoints(player){return v20Fmv(player)*v20ExpectedGames(player);}
  function v20UsefulSeasonPoints(player){return v20RawSeasonPoints(player)*v20SlotUsage(player);}
  function v20IndexBreakdown(player){
    const fmv=v20Fmv(player),games=v20ExpectedGames(player),usage=v20SlotUsage(player),raw=fmv*games,useful=raw*usage,cpp=v20CreditPerPoint(),value=useful*cpp;
    return {fmv,games,usage,raw,useful,creditPerPoint:cpp,value,targetAverage:v20TargetAverage(),roundsRemaining:v20RoundsRemaining(),budget:v20InitialBudget(),slot:clamp20(Math.round(n20(player?.slot)??4),1,8)};
  }
  window.v20IndexBreakdown=v20IndexBreakdown;
  window.v20SlotUsageWeight=v20SlotUsage;

  strategicValueIndex=function(player){
    return Math.max(0,Math.round(v20IndexBreakdown(player).value));
  };
  strategicIndexTitle=function(player){
    const x=v20IndexBreakdown(player),value=Math.max(0,Math.round(x.value));
    return `Indice ${value} cr · valore fisso di produzione · FMV ${x.fmv.toFix

  /*
   * INDICE V20
   * Valore fisso in crediti della produzione fantacalcistica attesa.
   * NON usa PFC, PMA, prezzo atteso, soglia, offerte o andamento mercato.
   *
   * 1) Target stagionale ancora da produrre = media-vittoria × giornate residue.
   * 2) Ogni fantapunto utile vale = budget iniziale / target stagionale.
   * 3) Punti utili giocatore = FMV × gare attese × peso utilizzo fantasy.
   * 4) Indice = punti utili × crediti per fantapunto.
   *
   * Gare attese include titolarità prevista e indisponibilità note.
   * Il peso utilizzo fantasy evita di valorizzare allo stesso modo titolari e riserve:
   * slot 1-3 sono presumibilmente da XI, slot 4-8 progressivamente da rotazione/panchina.
   */
  const V20_SLOT_USAGE=Object.freeze({1:1.00,2:.92,3:.80,4:.55,5:.38,6:.26,7:.16,8:.10});
  const n20=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null;
  const clamp20=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));

  function v20NextRound(){return clamp20(Number(state.v13NextRound||state.setup?.next_round||1),1,38);}
  function v20RoundsRemaining(){return Math.max(0,39-v20NextRound());}
  function v20Fmv(player){
    const v=typeof strategicExpectedFantasyAverage==='function'?n20(strategicExpectedFantasyAverage(player)):n20(player?.expected_fantasy_avg);
    return Math.max(0,v??0);
  }
  function v20Presence(player){
    const v=typeof strategicPresencePercent==='function'?n20(strategicPresencePercent(player)):n20(player?.expected_titolarity);
    return clamp20(v??0,0,100);
  }
  function v20ExpectedGames(player){
    const remaining=v20RoundsRemaining();
    const next=v20NextRound();
    const until=Math.max(0,n20(player?.unavailable_until_round)??0);
    const forcedMiss=until>=next?Math.min(remaining,until-next+1):0;
    const available=Math.max(0,remaining-forcedMiss);
    return available*v20Presence(player)/100;
  }
  function v20SlotUsage(player){
    const slot=clamp20(Math.round(n20(player?.slot)??4),1,8);
    return V20_SLOT_USAGE[slot]??.55;
  }
  function v20TargetAverage(){
    const v=typeof strategicWinningTargetAverage==='function'?n20(strategicWinningTargetAverage()):null;
    return Math.max(1,v??72);
  }
  function v20InitialBudget(){
    return Math.max(1,n20(state.auction?.settings?.initial_credits)??n20(state.setup?.initial_credits)??500);
  }
  function v20CreditPerPoint(){
    const totalTarget=v20TargetAverage()*v20RoundsRemaining();
    return totalTarget>0?v20InitialBudget()/totalTarget:0;
  }
  function v20RawSeasonPoints(player){return v20Fmv(player)*v20ExpectedGames(player);}
  function v20UsefulSeasonPoints(player){return v20RawSeasonPoints(player)*v20SlotUsage(player);}
  function v20IndexBreakdown(player){
    const fmv=v20Fmv(player),games=v20ExpectedGames(player),usage=v20SlotUsage(player),raw=fmv*games,useful=raw*usage,cpp=v20CreditPerPoint(),value=useful*cpp;
    return {fmv,games,usage,raw,useful,creditPerPoint:cpp,value,targetAverage:v20TargetAverage(),roundsRemaining:v20RoundsRemaining(),budget:v20InitialBudget(),slot:clamp20(Math.round(n20(player?.slot)??4),1,8)};
  }
  window.v20IndexBreakdown=v20IndexBreakdown;
  window.v20SlotUsageWeight=v20SlotUsage;

  strategicValueIndex=function(player){
    return Math.max(0,Math.round(v20IndexBreakdown(player).value));
  };
  strategicIndexTitle=function(player){
    const x=v20IndexBreakdown(player),value=Math.max(0,Math.round(x.value));

  function timer23(){
    const s=session23();if(!s?.current_player_id)return '—';if(s.hold_active)return 'HOLD';
    const now=Date.now()+Number(state.serverOffsetMs||0),start=Date.parse(s.timer_starts_at||''),end=Date.parse(s.timer_deadline||'');
    if(Number.isFinite(start)&&now<start)return `${Math.max(0,Math.ceil((start-now)/1000))}s`;

  }

    function strategicThresholdPrice(player) {
      const expectedPrice = strategicExpectedPrice(player);
      const fm = strategicExpectedFantasyAverage(player);
      const presence = strategicPresencePercent(player) / 100;
      const targetPerPlayer = strategicWinningTargetAverage() / 11;
      const trend = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, strategicFeature(player, 'trend_age_adjusted', 0) || 0));
      const volatility = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, strategicFeature(player, 'volatility', .22) || 0));
      const slot = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, Number(player?.slot || 4)));
      const coverage = .55 + .45 * presence;
      const quality = targetPerPlayer > 0 ? (fm * coverage) / targetPerPlayer : 1;
      const trendFactor = 1 + trend * .10;
      const riskFactor = 1 - volatility * .10;
      const slotFactor = 1 + Math.max(0, 4 - slot) * .025;
      const contributionFactor = Math.max(.52, Math.min(1.72, quality * trendFactor * riskFactor * slotFactor));
      const initialCredits = Number(state.auction?.settings?.initial_credits || state.setup?.initial_credits || 500);
      return Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.round(initialCredits * .38), Math.round(expectedPrice * contributionFactor)));
    }

    function strategicValueIndex(player) {
      const threshold = strategicThresholdPrice(player);
      let denominator = strategicExpectedPrice(player);
      const session = state.auction?.auctionSession;
      if (session?.current_player_id === player?.id && Number(session?.current_bid || 0) > 0) denominator = Number(session.current_bid);
      return Math.max(1, Math.round((threshold / Math.max(1, denominator)) * 100));
    }

    function strategicIndexTitle(player) {
      return `Indice valore/prezzo: ${strategicValueIndex(player)} · soglia ${strategicThresholdPrice(player)} cr · prezzo atteso ${Math.round(strategicExpectedPrice(player))} cr · FV ${strategicExpectedFantasyAverage(player).toFixed(2)} · presenza ${Math.round(strategicPresencePercent(player))}%`;
    }

    function auctionViceInterestsFor(playerId) {
      return (
        state.auction?.viceInterests
          ?.[String(playerId)]
        || []
      );
    }


    function auctionOwnViceInterest(playerId) {
      return auctionViceInterestsFor(playerId)
        .find(item => item?.mine === true)
        || null;
    }


    function auctionPlayerIsQueued(playerId) {
      return auctionQueueRows()
        .some(item => item.player_id === playerId);
    }


    function auctionViceInterestTitle(item) {
      if (!item) {
        return '';
      }

      if (item.type === 'price') {
        return `${item.viceUsername || 'Vice'} · prezzo desiderato ${Number(item.amount || 0)}`;
      }

      const meta = AUCTION_VICE_INTERESTS[item.type];
      return `${item.viceUsername || 'Vice'} · ${meta?.label || item.type || 'segnale'}`;
    }


    function renderAuctionViceInterestReadout(
      playerId,
      { compact = false } = {}
    ) {
      if (!auctionHasPresidentRole()) {
        return '';
      }

      const interests =
        auctionViceInterestsFor(playerId);

      if (!interests.length) {
        return '';
      }

      return `
        <span class="auction-vice-interest-readout ${compact ? 'is-compact' : ''}">
          ${interests.map(item => {
            if (item.type === 'price') {
              return `
                <span
                  class="auction-vice-interest-badge is-price"
                  title="${esc(auctionViceInterestTitle(item))}"
                >V ${Number(item.amount || 0)}</span>
              `;
            }

            const meta =
              AUCTION_VICE_INTERESTS[item.type]
              || { emoji: '•', label: item.type || 'Segnale' };

            return `
              <span
                class="auction-vice-interest-badge"
                title="${esc(auctionViceInterestTitle(item))}"
              >${meta.emoji}</span>
            `;
          }).join('')}
        </span>
      `;
    }

    async function sendViceInterest(
      playerId,
      type,
      amount = null
    ) {
      if (!auctionHasViceRole()) {
        return;
      }

      const own =
        auctionOwnViceInterest(playerId);

      const nextType =
        own?.type === type
        && type !== 'price'
          ? 'clear'
          : type;

      if (
        nextType === 'price'
        && (
          !Number.isInteger(Number(amount))
          || Number(amount) < 1
        )
      ) {
        return msg(
          'Inserisci un prezzo desiderato valido.',
          'warning'
        );
      }

      try {
        await api(
          ENDPOINTS.auction,
          {
            action: 'sendViceSignal',
            playerId,
            signalType: nextType,
            amount:
              nextType === 'price'
                ? Number(amount)
                : null
          }
        );

        scheduleAuctionReconcile(350);
      } catch (error) {
        msg(error.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    function renderAuctionTurnIndicator({ mobile = false } = {}) {

    function auctionQueueModeAvailable() {
      const s =
        auctionSession();

      if (
        !s
        ||
        !auctionCallMode()
        ||
        !(auctionHasPresidentRole() || auctionHasViceRole())
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      /*
       * CODA è disponibile in QUALSIASI momento diverso
       * dal vero turno di chiamata personale:
       *
       * - lotto di un altro Presidente in corso       -> CODA
       * - lotto chiamato da me ancora in corso        -> CODA
       * - attesa del turno di un altro Presidente     -> CODA
       * - mio turno, nessun giocatore ancora chiamato -> OK
       */
      return Boolean(
        s.current_player_id
        ||
        s.current_nomination_team_id
          !== auctionMyTeamId()
      );
    }


    function auctionCanManageCallQueue() {
      return Boolean(
        auctionSession()
        &&
        auctionCallMode()
        &&
        auctionHasPresidentRole()
      );
    }


    function auctionQueueRows() {
      return (

    }


    /*
     * PAUSA CODA PERSISTENTE
     *
     * La preferenza autorevole vive in auction_team_state. Durante il breve
     * intervallo fra click e conferma server conserviamo però un "intent"
     * locale: se il browser viene ricaricato prima che il POST termini,
     * l'interfaccia non torna ad autoplay e il nuovo caricamento ritenta
     * silenziosamente il salvataggio.
     */
    const auctionQueuePausePersistInFlight =
      new Set();


    function auctionQueuePauseContext(data = state.auction) {
      const sessionId =
        data?.auctionSession?.id
        ||
        null;

      const teamId =
        data?.myTeam?.teamId
        ||
        data?.myTeam?.team?.id
        ||
        (
          data === state.auction
            ? auctionMyTeamId()
            : null
        );

      if (!sessionId || !teamId) {
        return null;
      }

      return {
        sessionId,
        teamId,
        key:
          `fantacalcio:auction-queue-paused:${sessionId}:${teamId}`
      };
    }


    function auctionQueuePausePending(data = state.auction) {
      const context =
        auctionQueuePauseContext(data);

      if (!context) {
        return null;
      }

      try {
        const raw =
          localStorage.getItem(
            context.key
          );

        if (!raw) {
          return null;
        }

        const parsed =
          JSON.parse(raw);

        if (
          typeof parsed?.paused
          !== 'boolean'
        ) {
          localStorage.removeItem(
            context.key
          );
          return null;
        }

        return {
          ...context,
          paused:
            parsed.paused === true,
          updatedAt:
            Number(parsed.updatedAt || 0)
        };
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }


    function setAuctionQueuePausePending(
      paused,
      data = state.auction
    ) {
      const context =
        auctionQueuePauseContext(data);

      if (!context) {
        return null;
      }

      localStorage.setItem(
        context.key,
        JSON.stringify({
          paused:
            paused === true,
          updatedAt:
            Date.now()
        })
      );

      return context;
    }


    function clearAuctionQueuePausePending(
      data = state.auction,
      expectedPaused = null
    ) {
      const pending =
        auctionQueuePausePending(data);

      if (!pending) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        expectedPaused !== null
        &&
        pending.paused
          !== (expectedPaused === true)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      localStorage.removeItem(
        pending.key
      );
    }


    function persistAuctionQueuePaused(
      paused,
      {
        data = state.auction,
        quiet = false
      } = {}
    ) {
      const context =
        auctionQueuePauseContext(data);

      if (!context) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
      }

      const desired =
        paused === true;

      const flightKey =
        `${context.sessionId}:${context.teamId}:${desired ? '1' : '0'}`;

      if (
        auctionQueuePausePersistInFlight
          .has(flightKey)
      ) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
      }

      auctionQueuePausePersistInFlight
        .add(flightKey);

      return api(
        ENDPOINTS.auction,
        {
          action:
            'setCallQueuePaused',
          sessionId:
            context.sessionId,
          paused:
            desired
        },
        {
          quiet,
          keepalive:
            true
        }
      )
        .then(result => {
          if (result?.ok) {
            clearAuctionQueuePausePending(
              data,
              desired
            );

            if (
              state.auction
              &&
              state.auction
                ?.auctionSession
                ?.id
                === context.sessionId
            ) {
              state.auction.callQueueSettings = {
                ...(state.auction.callQueueSettings || {}),
                autoPaused:
                  desired
              };
            }
          }

          return result;
        })
        .catch(error => {
          /*
           * L'intent locale NON viene cancellato: in caso di reload/rete
           * instabile il prossimo getLobby ritenta il salvataggio.
           */
          if (!quiet) {
            msg(
              `${error.message} La preferenza verrà ritentata automaticamente.`,
              'error'
            );
          }

          return null;
        })
        .finally(() => {
          auctionQueuePausePersistInFlight
            .delete(flightKey);
        });
    }

      data
    ) {
      const pending =
        auctionQueuePausePending(data);

      if (!pending) {
        return data;
      }

      const serverPause

    function mergeAuctionQueuePausePending(
      data
    ) {
      const pending =
        auctionQueuePausePending(data);

      if (!pending) {
        return data;
      }

      const serverPaused =
        data?.callQueueSettings
          ?.autoPaused === true;

      data.callQueueSettings = {
        ...(data.callQueueSettings || {}),
        autoPaused:
          pending.paused
      };

      if (
        serverPaused
        === pending.paused
      ) {
        clearAuctionQueuePausePending(
          data,
          pending.paused
        );
      } else {
        /*
         * Un refresh può aver interrotto il POST precedente. Non blocchiamo
         * il rendering: riproviamo in background con fetch keepalive.
         */
        void persistAuctionQueuePaused(
          pending.paused,
          {
            data,
            quiet:
              true
          }
        );
      }

      return data;
    }


    function auctionQueueProjection(rows = auctionQueueRows()) {
      const info =
        auctionMyTeamDashboardData();

      const normalizedRows =
        Array.isArray(rows)
          ? rows
          : [];

      if (!info) {
        return normalizedRows.map(item => ({
          item,
          backup: false,
          reason: ''
        }));
      }

      const mode =
        state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode
        || 'classic';

      const assignments =
        info.assignments || [];

      const totalMaximum =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            info.rosterMax
            || info.rosterLimit
            || 0
          )
        );

      let projectedTotal =
        assignments.length;

      if (mode === 'classic') {
        const roleUsed = {};

        ['P', 'D', 'C', 'A'].forEach(role => {
          roleUsed[role] =
            assignments.filter(item =>
              item.player?.classic_role === role
            ).length;
        });

        return normalizedRows.map(item => {
          const role =
            item.player?.classic_role
            || '—';

          const roleMaximum =
            Math.max(
              0,
              Number(
                info.roleLimits?.[role]?.max
                || 0
              )
            );

          const totalFull =
            totalMaximum > 0
            && projectedTotal >= totalMaximum;

          const roleFull =
            roleMaximum <= 0
            || Number(roleUsed[role] || 0) >= roleMaximum;

          const backup =
            totalFull || roleFull;

          let reason = '';

          if (backup) {
            reason = totalFull
              ? `Backup: supererebbe il massimo totale di ${totalMaximum} giocatori.`
              : `Backup: supererebbe il massimo ${role} di ${roleMaximum} giocatori.`;
          } else {
            projectedTotal += 1;
            roleUsed[role] =
              Number(roleUsed[role] || 0) + 1;
          }

          return {
            item,
            backup,
            reason
          };
        });
      }

      const isGoalkeeper = candidate =>
        playerRoles(candidate || {}, mode)
          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));

      let goalkeeperUsed =
        assignments.filter(item =>
          isGoalkeeper(item.player)
        ).length;

      let movementUsed =
        assignments.length - goalkeeperUsed;

      const goalkeeperMaximum =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            info.roleLimits?.Por?.max
            || totalMaximum
          )
        );

      const movementMaximum =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            info.roleLimits?.MOV?.max
            || totalMaximum
          )
        );

      return normalizedRows.map(item => {
        const goalkeeper =
          isGoalkeeper(item.player);

        const bucketMaximum =
          goalkeeper
            ? goalkeeperMaximum
            : movementMaximum;

        const bucketUsed =
          goalkeeper
            ? goalkeeperUsed
            : movementUsed;

        const totalFull =
          totalMaximum > 0
          && projectedTotal >= totalMaximum;

        const bucketFull =
          bucketMaximum > 0
          && bucketUsed >= bucketMaximum;

        const backup =
          totalFull || bucketFull;

        let reason = '';

        if (backup) {
          reason = totalFull
            ? `Backup: supererebbe il massimo totale di ${totalMaximum} giocatori.`
            : `Backup: supererebbe il massimo ${goalkeeper ? 'portieri' : 'movimento'} di ${bucketMaximum} giocatori.`;
        } else {
          projectedTotal += 1;

          if (goalkeeper) {
            goalkeeperUsed += 1;
          } else {
            movementUsed += 1;
          }
        }

        return {
          item,
          backup,
          reason
        };
      });
    }

    function auctionQueueCapacityForPlayer(player) {
      const queue =
        auctionQueueRows();

      /*

       * rosa finale: può quindi contenere anche giocatori di backup oltre i

        }

        projected[projected.length - 1]
        || null;

      return {

        backup:
          stateForPlayer?.backup === true,
        message:
          stateForPlayer?.reason || ''
      };
    }

            : missing > 0

              : 8;

            : missing > 0
              ? `${role} già coperto in Coda, ma non ancora acquistato`

      } else {

          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
        const bucket = goalkeeper ? 'Por' : 'MOV';
        const label = goalkeeper ? 'portieri' : 'movimento';
        const min = Number(info.roleLimits?.[bucket]?.min || 0);
        const isGoalkeeper = candidate => playerRoles(candidate || {}, mode)
          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
        const acquired = assignments.filter(item => goalkeeper === isGoalkeeper(item.player)).length;
        const queued = queue.filter(item => goalkeeper === isGoalkeeper(item.player)).length;
        const uncovered = Math.max(0, min - acquired - queued);

        needScore = uncovered > 0 ? 76 + Math.min(18, uncovered * 7) : 10;
        needLabel = uncovered > 0
          ? `Mancano ${uncovered} ${label} al minimo`
          : `${label[0].toUpperCase()+label.slice(1)} compatibile con la rosa`;
      }

      const pfc = Number(player.pfc || 0);
      const pma = Number(player.pma || 0);
      const expectedFm = Number(player.expected_fantasy_avg || 0);
      const tit = Number(player.expected_titolarity || 0);
      const quotation = Number(player.quotation || 0);
      const slot = Number(player.slot || 0);
      const maxBid = Number(info.maxBid ?? info.remaining ?? 0);

      let valueScore =
        Math.min(24, Math.max(0, pfc) * .18)
        + Math.min(18, Math.max(0, pma) * .12)
        + Math.min(12, Math.max(0, expectedFm) * 1.1)
        + Math.min(10, Math.max(0, tit) * .10);

      if (slot > 0) {
        valueScore += Math.max(0, 14 - slot * 2.5);
      }

      let budgetScore = 0;

        slot
      };
    }


    function auctionSuggestedCalls(limit = 4) {
      if (
        !auctionCallMode()
        || !(auctionHasPresidentRole() || auctionHasViceRole())
      ) {
        return [];
      }

      return (state.auction?.callCandidates || [])
        .map(auctionSuggestedCallScore)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) =>
          b.score - a.score
          || Number(b.player?.pfc || 0) - Number(a.player?.pfc || 0)
          || Number(b.player?.pma || 0) - Number(a.player?.pma || 0)
          || String(a.player?.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.player?.name || ''), 'it')
        )
        .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(limit || 4)));
    }

    function attachAuctionQueueDrawerToggle() {
      $('auction-call-queue-drawer')
        ?.addEventListener(
          'toggle',

            state.auctionQueueOpen =
              event.currentTarget.open;
          }
        );
    }


    function attachAuctionRosterQueueToggle() {
      $('auction-roster-queue-toggle')
        ?.addEventListener(
          'change',
          event => {
            state.auctionShowQueueInRoster =
              event.currentTarget.checked;

            renderAuctionLive();
          }
        );
    }



    function auctionOptimisticQueueRows(items) {
      const currentRows =
        auctionQueueRows();

      const candidates =
        state.auction?.callCandidates
        || [];

      return items.map((item, index) => {
        const playerId =
          item.playerId;

        const existing =
          currentRows.find(row =>
            row.player_id === playerId
          );

        const player =
          existing?.player
          || candidates.find(candidate =>
            candidate.id === playerId
          )
          || null;

        return {
          ...(existing || {}),
          player_id: playerId,
          player,
          opening_bid: Math.max(1, Number(item.openingBid || 1)),
          position: index + 1
        };
      });
    }


    function patchAuctionCallQueueUi() {
      const currentDrawer =
        $('auction-call-queue-drawer');

      const currentList =
        $('auction-call-queue-list');

      const queueScrollTop =
        currentList?.scrollTop
        || 0;

      if (currentDrawer) {
        const holder =
          document.createElement('div');

        holder.innerHTML =
          renderAuctionCallQueue().trim();

        const nextDrawer =
          holder.firstElementChild;

        if (nextDrawer) {
          currentDrawer.replaceWith(nextDrawer);
        }
      }

      attachAuctionCallQueueEvents();
      bindAuctionViceInterestControls($('auction-call-queue-drawer') || document);
      attachAuctionQueueDrawerToggle();
      attachAuctionRosterQueueToggle();

      const nextList =
        $('auction-call-queue-list');

      if (nextList) {
        nextList.scrollTop = queueScrollTop;
      }

      renderAuctionPlayers();

      if (state.auctionShowQueueInRoster) {
        const currentRoster =
          document.querySelector(
            '.auction-lower-main > .auction-team-column'
          );

        if (currentRoster) {
          const holder =
            document.createElement('div');

          holder.innerHTML =
            renderAuctionCockpitTeamPanel('roster').trim();

          const nextRoster =
            holder.firstElementChild;

          if (nextRoster) {
            currentRoster.replaceWith(nextRoster);
            attachAuctionRosterQueueToggle();
          }
        }
      }

    }


    async function saveAuctionCallQueueItems(
      items,
      successText = ''
    ) {
      const sessionId =
        auctionSession()?.id;

      if (!sessionId) {
        return;
      }

      const previousRows =
        [...auctionQueueRows()];

      const mutationVersion =
        ++state.auctionQueueMutationVersion;

      state.auctionQueueMutationPending =
        true;

      state.auction.myCallQueue =
        auctionOptimisticQueueRows(items);

      patchAuctionCallQueueUi();

      /* Lascia al browser un frame per mostrare subito il nuovo stato. */
      await new Promise(resolve =>
        requestAnimationFrame(resolve)
      );

      const save = async () => {
        try {
          await api(
            ENDPOINTS.auction,
            {
              action:
                'saveCallQueue',

              sessionId,

              items
            }
          );

          if (
            mutationVersion
            === state.auctionQueueMutationVersion
          ) {
            state.auctionQueueMutationPending =
              false;

            if (successText) {
              msg(
                successText,
                'success'
              );
            }

            if (!auctionRealtimeSubscribed) {
              scheduleAuctionReconcile(5000);
            }
          }

        } catch (error) {
          if (
            mutationVersion
            === state.auctionQueueMutationVersion
          ) {
            state.auctionQueueMutationPending =
              false;

            state.auction.myCallQueue =
              previousRows;

            patchAuctionCallQueueUi();
          }

          msg(
            `Coda non aggiornata: ${error.message}`,
            'error'
          );
        }
      };

      const queuedSave =
        auctionQueueSaveChain.then(save, save);

      auctionQueueSaveChain =
        queuedSave.catch(() => {});

      await queuedSave;
    }

    async function addPlayerToAuctionQueue(
      playerId,
      requestedOpeningBid = 1
    ) {
      if (!auctionCanManageCallQueue()) {
        return;
      }

      const d =
        state.auction;

      const player =
        (d.callCandidates || [])
          .find(
            item =>
              item.id === playerId
          );

      if (!player) {
        return;
      }

      if (!auctionPlayerMatchesCurrentRolePhase(player)) {
        return msg(
          `Durante la fase ${auctionRolePhaseLabel(state.auction?.rolePhase?.key)} puoi consultare questo giocatore, ma non inserirlo in coda.`,
          'warning'
        );
      }

      const existing =
        auctionQueueRows();

      if (
        existing.some(
          item =>
            item.player_id
            === playerId
        )
      ) {
        return msg(
          'Il giocatore è già nella coda.',
          'warning'
        );
      }

      const capacity =
        auctionQueueCapacityForPlayer(
          player
        );

      if (!capacity.allowed) {
        return msg(
          capacity.message,
          'warning'
        );
      }

      const openingBid =
        Math.max(
          1,
          Number(
            requestedOpeningBid
            ||
            1
          )
        );

      const items = [
        ...existing.map(
          item => ({
            playerId:
              item.player_id,

            openingBid:
              Number(
                item.opening_bid
                ||
                1
              )
          })
        ),

        {
          playerId,
          openingBid
        }
      ];

      await saveAuctionCallQueueItems(
        items
      );
    }


    function attachAuctionCallQueueEvents() {

        $('auction-call-queue-list');

        return;

              auctionSession()?.id;

            if (!sessionId) {
              return;

              state.auction
                ?.callQueueSettings
                ?.autoPaused === true;

              !previous;

            /*
             * Aggiornamento immediato + intent persistente locale.
             * Il POST parte in background e usa keepalive, quindi un refresh
             * immediato non deve riattivare l'autoplay.
             */
            setAuctionQueuePausePending(
              next
            );

            state.auction.callQueueSettings = {
              ...(state.auction.callQueueSettings || {}),
              autoPaused:
                next
            };

            patchAuctionCallQueueUi();

            mutationVersion
            === state.auctionQueueMutationVersion
          ) {
            state.auctionQueueMutationPending =
              false;

            if (successText) {
              msg(
                successText,
                'success'
              );
            }

            if (!auctionRealtimeSubscribed) {
              scheduleAuctionReconcile(5000);
            }
          }

        } catch (error) {
          if (
            mutationVersion
            === state.auctionQueueMutationVersion
          ) {
            state.auctionQueueMutationPending =
              false;

            state.auction.myCallQueue =
              previousRows;

            patchAuctionCallQueueUi();
          }

          msg(
            `Coda non aggiornata: ${error.message}`,
            'error'
          );
        }
      };

      const queuedSave =
        auctionQueueSaveChain.then(save, save);

      auctionQueueSaveChain =
        queuedSave.catch(() => {});

      await queuedSave;
    }


    async function addPlayerToAuctionQueue(
      playerId,
      requestedOpeningBid = 1
    ) {
      if (!auctionCanManageCallQueue()) {
        return;
      }

      const d =
        state.auction;

      const player =
        (d.callCandidates || [])
          .find(
            item =>
              item.id === playerId
          );

      if (!player) {
        return;
      }

      if (!auctionPlayerMatchesCurrentRolePhase(player)) {
        return msg(
          `Durante la fase ${auctionRolePhaseLabel(state.auction?.rolePhase?.key)} puoi consultare questo giocatore, ma non inserirlo in coda.`,
          'warning'
        );
      }

      const existing =
        auctionQueueRows();

      if (
        existing.some(
          item =>
            item.player_id
            === playerId
        )
      ) {
        return msg(
          'Il giocatore è già nella coda.',
          'warning'
        );
      }

      const capacity =
        auctionQueueCapacityForPlayer(
          player
        );

      if (!capacity.allowed) {
        return msg(
          capacity.message,
          'warning'
        );
      }

      const openingBid =
        Math.max(
          1,
          Number(
            requestedOpeningBid
            ||
            1
          )
        );

      const items = [
        ...existing.map(
          item => ({
            playerId:
              item.player_id,

            openingBid:
              Number(
                item.opening_bid
                ||
                1
              )
          })
        ),

        {
          playerId,
          openingBid
        }
      ];

      await saveAuctionCallQueueItems(
        items
      );
    }


    function attachAuctionCallQueueEvents() {
      document
        .querySelectorAll('[data-suggest-call]')
        .forEach(button => {
          button.addEventListener('click', event => {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();

            addPlayerToAuctionQueue(
              button.dataset.suggestCall,
              Math.max(1, Number(state.auctionOpeningBid || 1))
            );
          });

        $('auction-call-queue-list');

        return;

      $('auction-queue-autoplay')
        ?.addEventListener(
          'click',
          () => {
            const sessionId =
              auctionSession()?.id;

            if (!sessionId) {
              return;
            }

            const previous =
              state.auction
                ?.callQueueSettings
                ?.autoPaused === true;

            const next =
              !previous;

            /*
             * Aggiornamento immediato + intent persistente locale.
             * Il POST parte in background e usa keepalive, quindi un refresh
             * immediato non deve riattivare l'autoplay.
             */
            setAuctionQueuePausePending(
              next
            );

            state.auction.callQueueSettings = {
              ...(state.auction.callQueueSettings || {}),
              autoPaused:
                next
            };

            patchAuctionCallQueueUi();

            void persistAuctionQueuePaused(
              next,
              {
                quiet:
                  false
              }
            );
          }
        );

      $('auction-queue-private')
        ?.addEventListener(
          'change',
          async event => {
            const sessionId = auctionSession()?.id;
            if (!sessionId) return;

            const previous =
              state.auction?.callQueueSettings?.private === true;
            const next = event.currentTarget.checked === true;

            state.auction.callQueueSettings = {
              ...(state.auction.callQueueSettings || {}),
              private: next
            };
            patchAuctionCallQueueUi();

            try {
              await api(
                ENDPOINTS.auction,
                {
                  action: 'setCallQueuePrivate',
                  sessionId,
                  private: next
                }
              );
                    if (!auctionRealtimeSubscribed) {
                scheduleAuctionReconcile(5000);
              }
            } catch (error) {
              state.auction.callQueueSettings = {
                ...(state.auction.callQueueSettings || {}),
                private: previous
              };
              patchAuctionCallQueueUi();
              msg(error.message, 'error');
            }
          }
        );

    async function loadAuctionPersonalRoster(force = false) {
      if (!state.auction?.auctionSession) {
        state.auctionPersonalRoster = null;
        state.auctionPersonalRosterFetchedAt = 0;
        return;
      }

      const now = Date.now();

      if (
        !force &&
        state.auctionPersonalRoster &&
        now - state.auctionPersonalRosterFetchedAt < 5000
      ) {
        return;
      }

      try {
        const data = await api(
          ENDPOINTS.rosters,
          { action: 'getRosters' },
          { quiet: true }
        );

        if (data?.ok) {
          state.auctionPersonalRoster = data;
          state.auctionPersonalRosterFetchedAt = Date.now();
        }

      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          'AUCTION ROSTERS:',
          error
        );
      }
    }

     {
        data = state.auction,

      } = {}
    ) {
      const context =
        auctionQueuePauseContext(data);

      if (!context) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
      }

      const desired =
        paused === true;

      const flightKey =
        `${context.sessionId}:${context.teamId}:${desired ? '1' : '0'}`;

      if (
        auctionQueuePausePersistInFlight
          .has(flightKey)
      ) {
        return Promise.resolve(null);
      }

      auctionQueuePausePersistInFlight
        .add(flightKey);

      return api(
        ENDPOINTS.auction,
        {
          action:
            'setCallQueuePaused',
          sessionId:
            context.sessionId,
          paused:
            desired
        },
        {
          quiet,
          keepalive:
            true
        }
      )
        .then(result => {
          if (result?.ok) {
            clearAuctionQueuePausePending(
              data,
              desired
            );

            if (
              state.auction
              &&
              state.auction
                ?.auctionSession
                ?.id
                === context.sessionId
            ) {
              state.auction.callQueueSettings = {
                ...(state.auction.callQueueSettings || {}),
                autoPaused:
                  desired
              };
            }
          }

          return result;
        })
        .catch(error => {
          /*
           * L'intent locale NON viene cancellato: in caso di reload/rete
           * instabile il prossimo getLobby ritenta il salvataggio.
           */
          if (!quiet) {
            msg(
              `${error.message} La preferenza verrà ritentata automaticamente.`,
              'error'
            );
          }

          return null;
        })
        .finally(() => {
          auctionQueuePausePersistInFlight
            .delete(flightKey);
        });
    }


    function mergeAuctionQueuePausePending(
      data
    ) {
      const pending =
        auctionQueuePausePending(data);

      if (!pending) {
        return data;
      }

      const serverPaused =
        data?.callQueueSettings
          ?.autoPaused === true;

      data.callQueueSettings = {
        ...(data.callQueueSettings || {}),
        autoPaused:
          pending.paused
      };

      if (
        serverPaused
        === pending.paused
      ) {
        clearAuctionQueuePausePending(
          data,
          pending.paused
        );
      } else {
        /*
         * Un refresh può aver interrotto il POST precedente. Non blocchiamo
         * il rendering: riproviamo in background con fetch keepalive.
         */
        void persistAuctionQueuePaused(
          pending.paused,
          {
            data,
            quiet:
              true
          }
        );
      }

      return data;
    }


    function auctionQueueProjection(rows = auctionQueueRows()) {
      const info =
        auctionMyTeamDashboardData();

      const normalizedRows =
        Array.isArray(rows)
          ? rows
          : [];

      if (!info) {
        return normalizedRows.map(item => ({
          item,
          backup: false,
          reason: ''
        }));
      }

      const mode =
        state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode
        || 'classic';

      const assignments =
        info.assignments || [];

      const totalMaximum =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            info.rosterMax
            || info.rosterLimit
            || 0
          )
        );

      let projectedTotal =
        assignments.length;

      if (mode === 'classic') {
        const roleUsed = {};

        ['P', 'D', 'C', 'A'].forEach(role => {
          roleUsed[role] =
            assignments.filter(item =>
              item.player?.classic_role === role
            ).length;
        });

        return normalizedRows.map(item => {
          const role =
            item.player?.classic_role
            || '—';

          const roleMaximum =
            Math.max(
              0,
              Number(
                info.roleLimits?.[role]?.max
                || 0
              )
            );

          const totalFull =
            totalMaximum > 0
            && projectedTotal >= totalMaximum;

          const roleFull =
            roleMaximum <= 0
            || Number(roleUsed[role] || 0) >= roleMaximum;

          const backup =
            totalFull || roleFull;

          let reason = '';

          if (backup) {
            reason = totalFull
              ? `Backup: supererebbe il massimo totale di ${totalMaximum} giocatori.`
              : `Backup: supererebbe il massimo ${role} di ${roleMaximum} giocatori.`;
          } else {
            projectedTotal += 1;
            roleUsed[role] =
              Number(roleUsed[role] || 0) + 1;
          }

          return {
            item,
            backup,
            reason
          };
        });
      }

      const isGoalkeeper = candidate =>
        playerRoles(candidate || {}, mode)
          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));

      let goalkeeperUsed =
        assignments.filter(item =>
          isGoalkeeper(item.player)
        ).length;

      let movementUsed =
        assignments.length - goalkeeperUsed;

      const goalkeeperMaximum =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            info.roleLimits?.Por?.max
            || totalMaximum
          )
        );

      const movementMaximum =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Number(
            info.roleLimits?.MOV?.max
            || totalMaximum
          )
        );

      return normalizedRows.map(item => {
        const goalkeeper =
          isGoalkeeper(item.player);

        const bucketMaximum =
          goalkeeper
            ? goalkeeperMaximum
            : movementMaximum;

        const bucketUsed =
          goalkeeper
            ? goalkeeperUsed
            : movementUsed;

        const totalFull =
          totalMaximum > 0
          && projectedTotal >= totalMaximum;

        const bucketFull =
          bucketMaximum > 0
          && bucketUsed >= bucketMaximum;

        const backup =
          totalFull || bucketFull;

        let reason = '';

        if (backup) {
          reason = totalFull
            ? `Backup: supererebbe il massimo totale di ${totalMaximum} giocatori.`
            : `Backup: supererebbe il massimo ${goalkeeper ? 'portieri' : 'movimento'} di ${bucketMaximum} giocatori.`;
        } else {
          projectedTotal += 1;

          if (goalkeeper) {
            goalkeeperUsed += 1;
          } else {
            movementUsed += 1;
          }
        }

        return {
          item,
          backup,
          reason
        };
      });
    }


    function auctionQueueCapacityForPlayer(player) {
      const queue =
        auctionQueueRows();

      /*
       * La Coda è una lista strategica, non una proiezione vincolante della
       * rosa finale: può quindi contenere anche giocatori di backup oltre i
       * massimi di rosa/ruolo. L'unico limite tecnico resta quello del backend
       * (50 record per salvataggio della Coda).
       */
      if (queue.length >= 50) {
        return {
          allowed: false,
          backup: false,
          message: 'La coda può contenere al massimo 50 giocatori.'
        };
      }

      if (!player) {
        return {
          allowed: true,
          backup: false,
          message: ''
        };
      }

      const hypothetical = [
        ...queue,
        {
          player_id: player.id,
          player
        }
      ];

      const projected =
        auctionQueueProjection(hypothetical);

      const stateForPlayer =
        projected[projected.length - 1]
        || null;

      return {
        allowed: true,
        backup:
          stateForPlayer?.backup === true,
        message:
          stateForPlayer?.reason || ''
      };
    }

    function auctionSuggestedCallScore(player) {
      const d = state.auction || {};
      const info = auctionMyTeamDashboardData();

      if (!player || !info) {
        return null;
      }

      if (!auctionPlayerMatchesCurrentRolePhase(player)) {
        return null;
      }

      const capacity = auctionQueueCapacityForPlayer(player);
      if (!capacity.allowed) {
        return null;
      }

      if (
        auctionQueueRows()
          .some(item => item.player_id === player.id)
      ) {
        return null;
      }

      const mode = d.settings?.fantasy_mode || 'classic';
      const assignments = info.assignments || [];
      const queue = auctionQueueRows();
      let needScore = 0;
      let needLabel = '';

      if (mode === 'classic') {
        const role = player.classic_role || '—';
        const min = Number(info.roleLimits?.[role]?.min || 0);
        const acquired = assignments.filter(item => item.player?.classic_role === role).length;
        const queued = queue.filter(item => item.player?.classic_role === role).length;
        const missing = Math.max(0, min - acquired);
        const uncovered = Math.max(0, min - acquired - queued);

        needScore =
          uncovered > 0
            ? 70 + Math.min(20, uncovered * 8)
            : missing > 0
              ? 42
              : 8;

        needLabel =
          uncovered > 0
            ? `Mancano ${uncovered} ${role} al minimo`
            : missing > 0
              ? `${role} già coperto in Coda, ma non ancora acquistato`
              : `Slot ${role} ancora disponibile`;
      } else {
        const goalkeeper = playerRoles(player, mode)
          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
        const bucket = goalkeeper ? 'Por' : 'MOV';
        const label = goalkeeper ? 'portieri' : 'movimento';
        const min = Number(info.roleLimits?.[bucket]?.min || 0);
        const isGoalkeeper = candidate => playerRoles(candidate || {}, mode)
          .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
        const acquired = assignments.filter(item => goalkeeper === isGoalkeeper(item.player)).length;
        const queued = queue.filter(item => goalkeeper === isGoalkeeper(item.player)).length;
        const uncovered = Math.max(0, min - acquired - queued);

        needScore = uncovered > 0 ? 76 + Math.min(18, uncovered * 7) : 10;
        needLabel = uncovered > 0
          ? `Mancano ${uncovered} ${label} al minimo`
          : `${label[0].toUpperCase()+label.slice(1)} compatibile con la rosa`;
      }

      const pfc = Number(player.pfc || 0);
      const pma = Number(player.pma || 0);
      const expectedFm = Number(player.expected_fantasy_avg || 0);
      const tit = Number(player.expected_titolarity || 0);
      const quotation = Number(player.quotation || 0);
      const slot = Number(player.slot || 0);
      const maxBid = Number(info.maxBid ?? info.remaining ?? 0);

      let valueScore =
        Math.min(24, Math.max(0, pfc) * .18)
        + Math.min(18, Math.max(0, pma) * .12)
        + Math.min(12, Math.max(0, expectedFm) * 1.1)
        + Math.min(10, Math.max(0, tit) * .10);

      if (slot > 0) {
        valueScore += Math.max(0, 14 - slot * 2.5);
      }

      let budgetScore = 0;
      if (quotation > 0 && maxBid > 0) {
        const ratio = quotation / maxBid;
        budgetScore =
          ratio <= .20 ? 14 :
          ratio <= .35 ? 11 :
          ratio <= .50 ? 7 :
          ratio <= .75 ? 3 : -8;
      }

      const backupPenalty =
        capacity.backup === true
          ? 38
          : 0;

      const score =
        needScore
        + valueScore
        + budgetScore
        - backupPenalty;

      let secondary = '';
      if (pfc > 0 || pma > 0) {
        secondary = `PFC ${pfc || '—'} · PMA ${pma || '—'}`;
      } else if (slot > 0) {
        secondary = `Slot ${slot}`;
      } else if (quotation > 0) {
        secondary = `Qt. ${quotation}`;
      }

      return {
        player,
        score,
        reason:
          capacity.backup
            ? `${needLabel} · Backup oltre capienza attuale`
            : needLabel,
        secondary,
        quotation,
        slot
      };
    }


    function auctionSuggestedCalls(limit = 4) {
      if (
        !auctionCallMode()
        || !(auctionHasPresidentRole() || auctionHasViceRole())
      ) {
        return [];
      }

      return (state.auction?.callCandidates || [])
        .map(auctionSuggestedCallScore)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) =>
          b.score - a.score
          || Number(b.player?.pfc || 0) - Number(a.player?.pfc || 0)
          || Number(b.player?.pma || 0) - Number(a.player?.pma || 0)
          || String(a.player?.name || '').localeCompare(String(b.player?.name || ''), 'it')
        )
        .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(limit || 4)));
    }

    function disconnectAuctionRealtime() {
      if (auctionReconcileTimer) {
        clearTimeout(auctionReconcileTimer);
        auctionReconcileTimer = null;
      }

      if (
        auctionRealtimeClient
        && auctionRealtimeChannel
      ) {
        try {
          auctionRealtimeClient.removeChannel(
            auctionRealtimeChannel
          );
        } catch {}
      }

      auctionRealtimeChannel = null;
      auctionRealtimeTopic = '';
      auctionRealtimeSubscribed = false;
    }


    function scheduleAuctionReconcile(delay = 80) {
      if (
        !state.session?.token
        || !['auction', 'tv'].includes(state.view)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (auctionReconcileTimer) {
        clearTimeout(auctionReconcileTimer);
      }

      auctionReconcileTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
        auctionReconcileTimer = null;

        if (
          refreshBusy
          || document.hidden
          || !['auction', 'tv'].includes(state.view)
        ) {
          scheduleAuctionReconcile(500);
          return;
        }

        refreshBusy = true;

        try {
          await loadAuction({
            quiet: true,
            onlyIfChanged: true
          });

          state.lastAuctionReconcileAt = Date.now();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('AUCTION RECONCILE:', error);
        } finally {
          refreshBusy = false;
        }
      }, Math.max(0, Number(delay || 0)));
    }
